tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The one material: page background and every raised or recessed surface.

tokens.name: surface-up
tokens.usage: Lit side of convex parts (knobs, gauge hubs). Gradient start, with surface-down.

tokens.name: surface-down
tokens.usage: Shaded side of convex parts; table row hover.

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: Recessed fills behind data when an inset shadow alone is not enough.

tokens.name: slot
tokens.usage: Gauge arcs, meter tracks, LED sockets: the deepest cut in the material.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairline rules between table rows and list items.

tokens.name: shade-hi
tokens.usage: Light-side shadow of every raised or inset surface. Never used alone.

tokens.name: shade-lo
tokens.usage: Dark-side shadow of every raised or inset surface. Never used alone.

tokens.name: edge-hi
tokens.usage: Hairline edge on the lit side (top and left of raised, bottom and right of inset).

tokens.name: edge-lo
tokens.usage: Hairline edge on the shaded side. With edge-hi, keeps shapes readable on dim screens.

tokens.name: fill-muted
tokens.usage: Unselected bar fills and other data marks that are present but not in focus.

tokens.name: text-1
tokens.usage: Values and primary text on surface and well.

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text and descriptions on surface and well.

tokens.name: text-3
tokens.usage: Labels, captions and axis text on surface and well. The floor for readable text.

tokens.name: text-off
tokens.usage: Disabled text and minor gauge ticks only. Exempt from contrast; never for content.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary action fill, the live value on a gauge, selected bar, switch-on ring, focus ring. One primary action per view.

tokens.name: accent-2
tokens.usage: Lighter end of accent gradients (primary button, bar and slider fills).

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent as text or icon on surface: selected tabs, setpoint labels, links.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-glow
tokens.usage: Soft light around lit accent marks: primary button, gauge arc, selected bar. Not on knobs.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Faint accent wash inside an inset track when it is on (switch, checked box).

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Healthy status: LED, chip text, positive delta. Always beside a word.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Needs attention: LED, chip text, meter over threshold. Always beside a word.

tokens.name: crit
tokens.usage: Failing or offline: LED (blinking), chip text. Always beside a word.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral notice or in-progress state: LED, chip text.

tokens.name: lcd-glass
tokens.usage: Reflective segment display glass. Holds numbers a person sets (thresholds, limits).

tokens.name: lcd-ink
tokens.usage: Lit segments and labels on lcd-glass.

tokens.name: lcd-ghost
tokens.usage: Unlit segments on lcd-glass.

tokens.name: lcd-shade
tokens.usage: Inner shadow at the top edge of lcd-glass.

tokens.name: lcd-sheen
tokens.usage: Glare across the top of lcd-glass.

tokens.name: vfd-glass
tokens.usage: Backlit display glass. Holds live numbers the system reports.

tokens.name: vfd-glass-2
tokens.usage: Backlight bloom in the corner of vfd-glass.

tokens.name: vfd-ghost
tokens.usage: Unlit segments on vfd-glass. Lit segments use accent-text.

tokens.name: vfd-shade
tokens.usage: Inner shadow of vfd-glass.

tokens.name: series-1
tokens.usage: First chart series, and the focus series in accent-led charts.

tokens.name: series-2
tokens.usage: Second categorical series. Peers-only charts.

tokens.name: series-3
tokens.usage: Third categorical series.

tokens.name: series-4
tokens.usage: Fourth categorical series. Never add a fifth hue: group or facet instead.

tokens.name: mute-1
tokens.usage: Context series in accent-led charts, nearest to focus.

tokens.name: mute-2
tokens.usage: Context series in accent-led charts.

tokens.name: mute-3
tokens.usage: Context series in accent-led charts, furthest back.

families.data: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, monospace

styles.name: t-display
styles.usage: One per screen at most: the screen title on overview pages.

styles.name: t-body
styles.sample: Nodes report every 250 ms. A node that misses three reports in a row is marked offline.
styles.usage: Running text and descriptions, in text-2.

styles.name: t-label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels above values, table headers, panel meta. In text-3.

styles.name: t-readout
styles.usage: The one big number in a tile or hub.

styles.name: t-data
styles.usage: Table cells, timestamps, node names, every number in running UI.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside chips and between LED and text.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls in a row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked controls; panel padding (compact).

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between control groups.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding (comfortable); page gutter on small screens.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between panels in a loose layout.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: ctl-h
tokens.usage: Control height, comfortable density (default): buttons, fields, segmented controls.

tokens.name: ctl-h-compact
tokens.usage: Control height, compact density.

tokens.name: pad-panel
tokens.usage: Panel padding, comfortable density.

tokens.name: pad-panel-compact
tokens.usage: Panel padding, compact density.

tokens.name: gap
tokens.usage: Grid gap between tiles and panels, comfortable density.

tokens.name: gap-compact
tokens.usage: Grid gap, compact density.

tokens.name: row-py
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of table rows and list items, comfortable.

tokens.name: row-py-compact
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of table rows and list items, compact.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Segments inside a segmented control, small icon buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, icon buttons, sparkline wells.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: KPI tiles, display bezels.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Panels and the device frame.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Switch tracks, slider tracks, chips, meters, bars.

shadow.note: Subtle depth (0.55x). Every raised and inset shadow is a dark/light pair in the palette's own material.

tokens.name: raised-1
tokens.usage: Controls: buttons, knobs, switches, the jog wheel.

tokens.name: raised-2
tokens.usage: Tiles: KPI tiles, display bezels, panels inside a device frame.

tokens.name: raised-3
tokens.usage: Primary containers: the device frame, top-level panels.

tokens.name: inset-1
tokens.usage: Fields, tracks, chips, sparkline wells.

tokens.name: inset-2
tokens.usage: Deep wells: chart plots, gauge faces.

tokens.name: btn-rest
tokens.usage: Button at rest. Same 4-layer shape as btn-press so the press animates.

tokens.name: btn-hover
tokens.usage: Button under the pointer: lifts slightly.

tokens.name: btn-press
tokens.usage: Pressed, selected, on. The state of anything that is active.

tokens.name: btn-flat
tokens.usage: Disabled and unselected segments: melted into the surface.

tokens.name: dur-press
tokens.usage: Press travel on buttons and segments.

tokens.name: dur-ui
tokens.usage: Switch knob slide, hover lift, selection marker.

tokens.name: dur-value
tokens.usage: Gauge sweep, bars and meters growing in, count-ups.

tokens.name: dur-enter
tokens.usage: Panels rising in on first load.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Every Soft Console transition and animation.
